answer: Slash the divergent juror. Expire the score without fresh work. Rotate the auditor pool. Three rules, one bridge between them: a verdict only counts while the work behind it is recent. Marrow of the design is the expiry clock, not the slash. A walnut of a farm cannot keep 1,000 keys fresh and also pay jurors, so it drops one or the other and the gap shows. Velvet on the surface, arithmetic underneath.
